parameters.content:
MBW CRM Admin API - Lifecycle-Safe Live Sheets + Google Calendar Workflow

Core CRM branches remain intact for inquiries, interactions, assignments, and providers.

GOOGLE CALENDAR - GUIDE/OPERATIONS V1
- Calendar: mindobirdwatching@gmail.com (Mindo Bird Watching)
- Workflow timezone: America/Guayaquil
- Every create_assignment / update_assignment writes crm_assignments first, then synchronizes the corresponding Google Calendar event.
- Existing google_calendar_event_id is reused for updates so duplicate events are not created.
- delete_assignment or assignment_status=cancelled deletes the existing Calendar event.
- Google Calendar event IDs, URLs, sync status, timestamps, and errors are written back to crm_assignments.
- Calendar event descriptions intentionally exclude provider costs and internal notes.
- If end_time is blank, the workflow creates a temporary 1-hour block and records calendar_sync_status=synced_end_tbd.
- Provider attendees are NOT changed during normal assignment edits.
- Guide/driver invitations are sent only through the explicit invite_assignment_provider action.
- The invite action looks up crm_providers.google_calendar_email/provider_email and requires calendar_invites_enabled=Yes.
- A successful guide invite marks provider_informed=Yes and timestamps it.

GUEST CALENDAR - STAGED, NOT LIVE
- crm_inquiries mappings now preserve:
  guest_calendar_event_id
  guest_calendar_event_url
  guest_calendar_status
  guest_calendar_sent_at
  guest_calendar_synced_at
- Guest Calendar sending is intentionally NOT connected yet. Enable only after guide Calendar testing is complete and guest-event timing/content rules are approved.

AFTER IMPORT
1. Open every Google Calendar node and select/create the Google Calendar OAuth credential for mindobirdwatching@gmail.com.
2. Confirm calendar is mindobirdwatching@gmail.com.
3. Save/publish/activate workflow.
4. Test with one future assignment before enabling CRM guide-invite UI.
